rationale: Switching to amino acid and acetate fermentation in the absence of carbohydrates. Stickland-like amino acid catabolism provides carbon, nitrogen, and energy. Acetate supplementation maintains reducing power balance. Fermentation products (acetate, butyrate, formate, CO₂) are typical of B. fragilis anaerobic metabolism. Carbon and nitrogen budgets close at growth rate 0.93 /h.
